scientific_integrity: The executable and recorded output are embedded. All purported numerical counts are from a reproducible full enumeration and two independent perfect-matching-count checks; no independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite \(H_{2\times2\times3}\) homotopy classification only; no general formula for longer honeycombs, no integral group-action classification, no conclusion for the ordinary matching complex. Unindexed equivalent prior work remains a literature risk. Acyclicity relies on the published successive-element-pairing theorem and the exhaustive terminal-cell certificate.
title: Two four-spheres in the perfect-matching complex of the \(2\times2\times3\) honeycomb
